# Abnormal AI — existing email security reference (2026-11-05)

**Canonical existing catalog ID:** `abnormal` in `lib/data/ecosystem.ts`; **do not add another Abnormal vendor or generic duplicate product.**  
**Status:** Source-backed public research only, not a reviewed feature-parity or independent efficacy claim.  
**Primary category:** existing `email-security`; ITDR is adjacent when account-takeover capabilities are evaluated.

## Vendor-described differentiators

- [Inbound Email Security](https://abnormal.ai/platform/inbound-email-security): a behavioral model of employees and vendors to identify phishing, BEC, impersonation and payload-less fraud. Vendor also describes investigation logs, cross-mailbox search/respond, and campaign-level remediation. Do not infer **pre-delivery transport-level interception** from promotional language like “before users engage.” 
- The same source also documents **custom rules, custom AI models and Detection 360**, in addition to behavioral detections. Do not describe Abnormal as lacking custom detection engineering or as strictly a black box.
- [AI Security Mailbox](https://abnormal.ai/platform/ai-security-mailbox): phishing-button and user-reported-email triage, employee feedback, and campaign-wide removal. Claimed analyst hour savings are marketing/commissioned-study outcomes, not independent typical results.
- Wider vendor platform material references identity, account and outbound capabilities that may require separate modules. Confirm module, licensing and incident scope before marking a comparison cell.

## Buyer fit to test

Behavioral BEC and seller/vendor impersonation risk, analyst overload from reported emails, or preference for automated detection with configurable controls. Run an authorized parallel evaluation against the existing Microsoft/Google/SEG baseline and candidate alternatives; don't assume reported results generalize.

## Gaps / next review

**Unknown:** per-user price, SKU entitlement for advanced modules, actual time-to-remediation distribution, false positive rate at the buyer's risk tolerance, operational approval rights, MSSP partner rights, regional data handling.
